note: contrat de services de transition conclu à la clôture du regroupement (la date n'est pas écrite dans le bloc) : Neuberger, vendeur de Dyal, fournit des services dont la sous-location des bureaux de Dyal ; Blue Owl lui rembourse certains frais de tiers ; montant non publié
quote: At the Closing of the Business Combination, Blue Owl entered into a Transition Services Agreement with Neuberger (the "Transition Services Agreement"), pursuant to which Neuberger has agreed to provide certain transition services, including, among other things, the sublease of Dyal office space at 1290 Avenue of the Americas, New York, New York
